result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major missing image placeholder in the 'Popular right now' section, a minor layout cutoff issue with the third card in 'Fastest near you', and a minor content inconsistency with the restaurant name being truncated.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken/placeholder image icon instead of an actual restaurant image
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset loads correctly or provide a fallback image for restaurants without photos

issues.description: The third card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the edge of the screen, truncating the restaurant name
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll/padding so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate more content is scrollable with a partial preview

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis, making it unclear if text is cut off intentionally or due to layout constraints
issues.suggestion: Add an ellipsis (...) or ensure text wrapping/truncation is handled consistently with proper CSS text-overflow styling
